verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly cover the story. Traces can be grouped into datasets, and datasets can collect data from production (docs-10, docs-41, docs-25, docs-65); gh-1 adds versioned datasets. Docs also cover running experiments and evaluations against those datasets: dataset evaluators act as a unit-test-like harness, code-based and LLM-as-judge evaluators are supported, results can be compared across runs, and SDKs are provided (docs-26, docs-18, docs-50, docs-76, docs-79). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration specifically of the trace-to-dataset curation and offline experiment workflow; the only community item is a generic endorsement of traces and evals.
